headline: Ødegaard: Arsenal on 'another level' after Champions League win continues unbeaten start
description: Martin Ødegaard has said Arsenal are "on another level" this season after winning the Premier League title gave Mikel Arteta's side a new level of confidence.

headline: The Premier League belongs to Erling Haaland after summer transfer window
description: The Premier League was once a league of superstars, but after a summer of clubs signing depth over singular talent, Haaland is now the biggest star left, though it hasn't dampened the league's popularity or power one bit.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United, Tottenham eye Club Brugge striker
description: Club Brugge striker Nicolo Tresoldi has emerged as a potential target for both Manchester United and Tottenham. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Mauricio Pochettino: Strip Chelsea of 2016-17 Premier League title and award it to Tottenham
description: Mauricio Pochettino has claimed Tottenham should be awarded the Premier League title from the 2016-17 campaign.

headline: Tottenham's Mykhailo Mudryk out until at least October with ankle injury - sources"
description: Mykhailo Mudryk is set to be sidelined until October at the earliest after suffering an ankle injury in training, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Liverpool prepare bid for Crystal Palace's Wharton
description: Liverpool could make a bid to sign Crystal Palace's Adam Wharton as soon as January. Transfer Talk has the latest.
